flags: CRITERIA (drop candidate): long-stay / workforce park with no live web presence. No operator website anywhere (Google Maps' website link is campnative.com; search finds only directories that say 'call for pricing'). The only RV camper report on RV Life (stayed 12/2021, motorhome) says: 'A basic campground designed for those staying for a month or more ... A few permanent residents, but mostly traveling workers who are stationed in the area. Open all winter.' A chamberofcommerce.com review cites monthly charges of $500 and $700. No nightly RV rate can be sourced (the one 2024+ camper report is a $20 tent night, 3/2025), so tests 1-2 of the long-stay rule can't be shown to pass.
Google Maps: 4.6 from 136 reviews (Miller's Campground & Gun Club, 6964 Township Line Rd, Waynesville; +1 513-897-0181).
Website field is the RV Life listing, not an operator site; there is no operator site to replace it with.
